metas.name: ★ 6.8 · 2023 · Barbie
metas.description: Barbie and Ken are having the time of their lives in the seemingly perfect world of Barbie Land. However, when they get a chance to go to the outside world, they soon discover the joys and perils of living among regular humans.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2022 · Avatar: The Way of Water
metas.description: Jake Sully lives with his newfound family formed on the extrasolar moon Pandora. Once a familiar threat returns to finish what was previously started, Jake must work with Neytiri and the army of the Na'vi race to protect their home.

metas.name: ★ 6.8 · 2022 · Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
metas.description: Doctor Strange teams up with a mysterious teenage girl who can travel across multiverses, to battle other-universe versions of himself which threaten to wipe out the multiverse. They seek help from the Scarlet Witch, Wong and others.

metas.name: ★ 8.4 · 2026 · The Odyssey
metas.description: After the Trojan War, Odysseus faces a dangerous voyage back to Ithaca, meeting creatures like the Cyclops Polyphemus, Sirens, and Calypso along the way.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2025 · Frankenstein
metas.description: Dr. Victor Frankenstein, a brilliant but egotistical scientist, brings a creature to life in a monstrous experiment that ultimately leads to the undoing of both the creator and his tragic creation.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2024 · Nosferatu
metas.description: A gothic tale of obsession between a haunted young woman and the terrifying vampire infatuated with her, causing untold horror in its wake.

metas.name: ★ 6.7 · 2025 · Mickey 17
metas.description: During a human expedition to colonize space, Mickey 17, a so-called "expendable" employee, is sent to explore an ice planet.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2024 · Wicked
metas.description: Elphaba, a young woman ridiculed for her green skin, and Galinda, a popular girl, become friends at Shiz University in the Land of Oz. After an encounter with the Wonderful Wizard of Oz, their friendship reaches a crossroads.

metas.name: ★ 6.6 · 2023 · The Flash
metas.description: Barry Allen uses his super speed to change the past, but his attempt to save his family creates a world without super heroes, forcing him to race for his life in order to save the future.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2023 · The Little Mermaid
metas.description: A young mermaid makes a deal with a sea witch to trade her beautiful voice for human legs so she can discover the world above water and impress a prince.

metas.name: ★ 6.6 · 2024 · Beetlejuice Beetlejuice

metas.name: ★ 6.8 · 2023 · Dream Scenario
metas.description: An ordinary family man finds his life turned upside down when strangers suddenly start seeing him in their dreams.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2022 · Werewolf by Night
metas.description: Follows a lycanthrope superhero who fights evil using the abilities given to him by a curse brought on by his bloodline.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2025 · The Life of Chuck
metas.description: A life-affirming, genre-bending story about three chapters in the life of an ordinary man named Charles Krantz.

metas.name: ★ 6.6 · 2025 · Wicked: For Good
metas.description: Elphaba, the future Wicked Witch of the West and her relationship with Glinda, the Good Witch of the North. The second of a two-part feature film adaptation of the Broadway musical.

metas.name: ★ 6.7 · 2022 · Three Thousand Years of Longing
metas.description: A lonely scholar, on a trip to Istanbul, discovers a Djinn who offers her three wishes in exchange for his freedom.

metas.name: ★ 6.9 · 2025 · Eternity

metas.description: A sequel to Karthikeya (2014), which deals with the personal problems of Karthikeya and how his pursuit of the truth leads him to find out the power of Indian ancient system and Tatva of Lord Sri Krishna.

metas.name: ★ 6.6 · 2022 · Spirited
metas.description: A musical version of Charles Dickens's story of a miserly misanthrope who is taken on a magical journey.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2024 · Better Man
metas.description: A singular profile of pop superstar Robbie Williams, chronicling his meteoric rise, dramatic fall, and remarkable resurgence.

metas.description: An imaginary place called Anjanadri where the protagonist gets the powers of Hanuman and fights for Anjanadri.
